name: Project Context page and the agent editor's Context tab render
description: Reaches Project Context through the sidebar (the repo id is resolved by the app, not hardcoded — the seeded stack has exactly one repo, acme/payments-api) and confirms the page renders one of its DEFINED states rather than a blank pane. Then opens an agent and switches to its Context tab to confirm the attachment surface renders with its 'attached' counter. Exercises the Project Context route, ProjectContextView's not-cloned state, and the shared ContextTab. Read-only seeded data: the seeded repo has no clone on disk, so the not-cloned state (AC-6/NFR-7) is the deterministic outcome here — a populated listing needs a real clone and is covered in the integration lane instead. Deliberately does NOT attach a document or start a review: this package's flows stay read-only and LLM-free.

steps.label: land on the seeded repo's PR list
open Project Context from the sidebar
the not-cloned state renders as its own state, never as an empty list (AC-6, NFR-7)
switch to the agent's Context tab
